record.question: El Niño refers to:
options: Warming of the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean
Formation of cyclones in the Atlantic
record.explanation: Answer A: Warming of the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean. El Niño is the episodic warming of central/eastern equatorial Pacific surface waters. Reference: https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/ninonina.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
